title: Detailed red car
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff6b6b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c81e1e'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glass' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#bde3ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#4a9bd1'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wind' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#8fd0ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3c86c4'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow under car -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='40' ry='5' fill='#2a0a0a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- car body main -->
  <path d='M8 66 L10 50 Q12 42 22 40 L34 40 L42 30 Q45 26 52 26 L68 26 Q78 26 82 34 L86 42 Q92 44 94 50 L95 60 Q95 66 90 66 Z'
        fill='url(#body)' stroke='#ff9a9a' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- lower body sill -->
  <rect x='10' y='62' width='84' height='6' rx='3' fill='#a81616'/>
  <rect x='10' y='63' width='84' height='2' rx='1' fill='#e04545' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- roof highlight -->
  <path d='M44 32 Q47 28 53 28 L67 28 Q75 28 78 34' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3b3' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- hood line -->
  <path d='M86 42 Q90 44 92 49' fill='none' stroke='#8f1010' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- rear window -->
  <path d='M36 40 L43 31 Q45 28 50 28 L51 28 L46 40 Z' fill='url(#glass)' stroke='#2b5f85' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- front windshield -->
  <path d='M54 28 Q68 28 72 34 L76 40 L57 40 Z' fill='url(#wind)' stroke='#2b5f85' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- side window -->
  <path d='M46 40 L51 28 L55 28 L57 40 Z' fill='#7fbce6' stroke='#2b5f85' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- pillar -->
  <rect x='52' y='28' width='2' height='12' fill='#c81e1e'/>

  <!-- door line -->
  <path d='M52 42 L52 62' stroke='#9a1414' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M74 42 L74 62' stroke='#9a1414' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- door handles -->
  <rect x='56' y='48' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ffd166' stroke='#c99a2e' stroke-width='0.6'/>
  <rect x='78' y='48' width='6' height='2.5' rx='1.2' fill='#ffd166' stroke='#c99a2e' stroke-width='0.6'/>

  <!-- headlight -->
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='51' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#fff3b0' stroke='#e8c94a' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='92' cy='51' rx='1.4' ry='1.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- taillight -->
  <rect x='8' y='48' width='3' height='6' rx='1.2' fill='#ff3b3b' stroke='#ffb0b0' stroke-width='0.6'/>

  <!-- front bumper -->
  <rect x='88' y='60' width='8' height='6' rx='3' fill='#d0d0d8' stroke='#a0a0aa' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <rect x='90' y='61' width='4' height='1.5' rx='0.7' fill='#f4f4f8'/>

  <!-- rear bumper -->
  <rect x='6' y='60' width='7' height='6' rx='3' fill='#d0d0d8' stroke='#a0a0aa' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- grille -->
  <rect x='89' y='55' width='5' height='3' rx='1' fill='#3a3a44'/>
  <path d='M90 55.5 L90 57.5 M92 55.5 L92 57.5 M94 55.5 L94 57.5' stroke='#8a8a96' stroke-width='0.5'/>

  <!-- side mirror -->
  <rect x='75' y='38' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#c81e1e' stroke='#ff9a9a' stroke-width='0.6'/>

  <!-- wheels -->
  <g>
    <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='12' fill='#26262e' stroke='#4a4a58' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='7' fill='#c0c0cc'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='3' fill='#8a8a98'/>
    <circle cx='26' cy='66' r='1.2' fill='#e0e0ea'/>
    <path d='M26 59 L26 62 M26 70 L26 73 M19 66 L22 66 M30 66 L33 66' stroke='#7a7a88' stroke-width='1'/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx='76' cy='66' r='12' fill='#26262e' stroke='#4a4a58' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='66' r='7' fill='#c0c0cc'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='66' r='3' fill='#8a8a98'/>
    <circle cx='76' cy='66' r='1.2' fill='#e0e0ea'/>
    <path d='M76 59 L76 62 M76 70 L76 73 M69 66 L72 66 M80 66 L83 66' stroke='#7a7a88' stroke-width='1'/>
  </g>

  <!-- wheel arches -->
  <path d='M14 66 Q14 52 26 52 Q38 52 38 66' fill='none' stroke='#8f1010' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M64 66 Q64 52 76 52 Q88 52 88 66' fill='none' stroke='#8f1010' stroke-width='2'/>

  <!-- reflection swoosh on body -->
  <path d='M30 44 Q46 41 60 44' fill='none' stroke='#ffc4c4' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
